attributes.name: The Olivaro Opuscules
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to display 3 random allies that have Diplomacy in their checks to acquire from the box. You may play each of these cards as if it is in your hand; after you do, banish it. At the end of the scenario, banish any that remain.

Banish this card to draw 3 random allies that have Diplomacy in their checks to acquire from the box.
